notes.title: Planet #2 Sneak Peek: hut on stilts
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, clay adventurers!

Today we want to share the modelling/sculpting process of an alien hut and a sneak peek at our second planet (WIP). It’s still early days, but hopefully you’ll catch some of the vibes we’re aiming for on this new world.
[/p][previewyoutube="I_HhzBp-rx4;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Claymation Impact Effects
notes.notes:
[p]Instead of the traditional particle system approach, we’re building our impact effects like stop-motion animations. It may seem like a small detail, but we think it makes every strike feel more physical and tactile.

[/p][previewyoutube="ZDqX82gG7GQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Here’s how it works:[/p][p]We start with 2D frame-by-frame doodles of the effect to nail the motion and timing.[/p][p]Each of those frames is then modelled in Blender as a 3D mesh.[/p][p]In Unity, when you land a hit, the game pulls from a pool of custom flipbook components that cycle through those meshes one after another.[/p][p]We’re happy with the results and plan to use this technique for most of the VFX in the game going forward.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: New Ability Showcase – Area Targeting & Explosive Impact
notes.notes: [p]This week, we’ve begun expanding our abilities toolkit, including explosive projectiles and backpack animations.[/p][p]One of the highlights is a new mid-range ability that lets players target a specific area and fire an explosive projectile. Upon impact, the projectile detonates, dealing area-of-effect damage. I am sure you will have fun exploding enemies from afar or not. [/p][previewyoutube="mGVmz9Q0CX4;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Master the timing of your weapon
notes.notes:
[p]When you equip a weapon, you’ll now gain access to a new ability that’s tied to a quick-time challenge.  A timing bar will appear next to your character, and if you press the ability button again within the highlighted window, you’ll flow into the next stage of your combo.

[/p][previewyoutube="cVxcTBhVCqk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Each weapon has its own unique combo chain, so a hammer might lead from a heavy opening swing into a crushing follow-up, while a sword could flow into a rapid flurry. The final hit in a combo is especially potent — delivering not just more damage, but also potentially a unique special effect, like inflicting a status ailment or knocking enemies off their feet.[/p][p]Timing your inputs well won’t just look and feel great, but also will be the key to unlocking your weapon’s true potential.[/p]

notes.title: Clayverse Update – New Ship Repairs & Upgrades!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="TuobNyXn9mc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey everyone! It’s been a little while since our last update, but we’ve been busy working on some cool new stuff for the game, and we’re excited to share it with you.[/p][p]When you first start your journey, the spaceship is going to be in rough conditions. You’ll now need to use some of the [b]clay [/b]you collect during your missions to [b]repair[/b] and [b]upgrade[/b] the ship. This will open up many new gameplay possibilities, like:[/p][list][*][p][b]Crafting[/b]: Craft powerful gear to help you survive tougher situations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customisation[/b]: Personalise your appearance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Talent Trees[/b]: Unlock new skills and abilities as you level up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Locations[/b]: As you progress, you’ll get to explore farther planets.[/p][/*][/list][p]And this is just the start – we’ve got a lot more ideas in the works to keep expanding and improving this feature going forward. [/p][p]Check out the sneak peek video below! (Heads up, it's still a work in progress, so the transition is a little rough right now, but we’re on it.)[/p]
